newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jordan's king to pay condolence visit to Israel.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's king to pay condolence visit to Israel.

text.p: Jordan's King Hussein will visit Israel on Sunday to pay condolences to the families of seven schoolgirls killed by one of his soldiers, a government spokesman said on Saturday.
The king expressed shame and shock after the attack, which came against a backdrop of worsening Jordanian-Israeli relations over Israeli settlement plans in Arab East Jerusalem.
"The king spoke by telephone with Prime Minister (Benjamin) Netanyahu yesterday afternoon," the spokesman said.
"The two agreed that the king will arrive on Sunday and will visit the families of the girls killed in Naharayim," he said.

Jordanian army driver Sergeant Ahmed Mousa Mustafa al-Daqamsa emptied the clip of his rifle on Thursday at the girls on a school trip to a strip of Jordanian land south of the Sea of Galilee leased to Israel under a 1994 peace treaty. He was arrested.
Jordan has launched an inquiry into his motives.
